selected_evidence.requirement: Allow the application to continue writing after rotation
selected_evidence.summary: The log inode remained unchanged, and a write through the pre-rotation open descriptor reached the active log after rotation.
Captured healthy baseline and boot ID, acknowledged the safe reboot, proved the boot ID changed, and confirmed the rule, compressed data, active timer, schedule, and log writability recovered.

    missingok
    notifempty
    copytruncate
}

commands.command:
set -eu
TEST_STATE=/tmp/inventory-logrotate-test.status
rm -f "$TEST_STATE"
exec 9>>/var/log/inventory/app.log
printf '%s\n' 'rotation-proof: written-before-rotation' >&9
sync
BEFORE_INODE=$(stat -c %i /var/log/inventory/app.log)
logrotate --force --state "$TEST_STATE" /etc/logrotate.d/inventory
printf '%s\n' 'rotation-proof: written-after-rotation-through-same-open-fd' >&9
sync
exec 9>&-
AFTER_INODE=$(stat -c %i /var/log/inventory/app.log)
printf 'INODE_BEFORE=%s INODE_AFTER=%s\n' "$BEFORE_INODE" "$AFTER_INODE"
printf 'ROTATED_FILES\n'; ls -l /var/log/inventory/app.log*
printf 'ROTATED_CONTENT_PROOF\n'; gzip -cd /var/log/inventory/app.log.1.gz | tail -n 5
printf 'CURRENT_CONTENT_PROOF\n'; tail -n 5 /var/log/inventory/app.log
printf 'GZIP_INTEGRITY\n'; gzip -t /var/log/inventory/app.log.1.gz && printf 'valid gzip\n'
printf 'STATE_POLICY\n'; logrotate --debug --state "$TEST_STATE" /etc/logrotate.d/inventory 2>&1 | grep -A7 'rotating pattern' | head -n 9
rm -f "$TEST_STATE"
